name: eval
complete_raw_region: def eval (r : Affine) (t : Point) : ℝ := r 0 + ∑ i : Fin 6, r i.succ * t i

name: coordinates
complete_raw_region:
def coordinates (c : Cell) (t : Point) : Point :=
  if mapped c then Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.chart t else t

/-- Every original named row is retained, including old activation/branch
exclusions. The chart is invertible by Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.physical_chart. -/

name: Source
complete_raw_region:
def Source (c : Cell) (t : Point) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ rows c, 0 < eval r (coordinates c t)

name: selectedSum
complete_raw_region: def selectedSum (c : Cell) (t : Point) : ℝ := Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.selectedSum (mask c) t

name: endpoint
complete_raw_region:
def endpoint (c : Cell) (t : Point) : ℝ :=
  (if descending c then 57 / 64 - 3 * selectedSum c t / 2
   else (1 + selectedSum c t) / 2) - Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.eta

/-- Descending pair17 is the actual old envelope of the four final
nonsingleton source cells, with x and the fifth coordinate p. -/

name: R17
complete_raw_region:
def R17 (t : Point) : ℝ := 57 / 64 - 3 * (t 0 + t 4) / 2

/-- Original comparison planes, including the last four pair17 parents.
G13's two comparison-only corrections install no further action. -/

name: comparison
complete_raw_region:
def comparison (c : Cell) (t : Point) : ℝ :=
  if comparisonChart c = 0 then Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.R0 t
  else if comparisonChart c = 1 then Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.descending33 t
  else if comparisonChart c = 2 then Certificates.P2OriginalSixthElevenLogSemantics.ascending34 t
  else R17 t

/-- The four pair17 sources carry the strict old-envelope gap in literal row 4. -/
